name: Rain
basis: Company release 2026-01-09: "Led by ICONIQ, with participation from Sapphire Ventures, Dragonfly, Bessemer Venture Partners, Galaxy Ventures, FirstMark, Lightspeed, Norwest, and Endeavor Catalyst." ($250M Series C; also Reuters 2026-01-09 via the Wikipedia article Rain (platform)). Whether Bessemer entered earlier than the Series C is not established.

name: Sifflet
basis: Tech.eu 2023-03-21: "The €12 million Series A round was led by EQT Ventures with existing seed round investors Bessemer Venture Partners and Mangrove Capital participating." Wikipedia (Sifflet) dates the seed to November 2021; Business Insider headline 2023-03-21 calls it "Bessemer-backed".

name: StayTerra
basis: Firm's own post 2026-01-28: "playing a meaningful role in key investments — including MaintainX, Legora, Canva, Luxury Presence, StayTerra, and Inertia"; FinSMEs 2025-07-18 (read): "received growth investment from Bessemer Venture Partners, joining existing investor, Garnett Station Partners". FLAG: also on the BVP Forge grid; vehicle not established (see forge).

name: ShopDeck
basis: Firm's own post 2026-03-05: "As a board observer at MeltPlan, Graph AI, Leena AI, Zenskar, Pepper Content, and ShopDeck, Aparna works closely with founders"; headline MarcaMoney 2024-12-01 "ShopDeck raises $8 million in Series B funding led by Bessemer Venture Partners" (India desk).

name: PrismTPO
basis: Firm's own post 2026-01-20: "the way she shows up in the boardrooms of PrismTPO, Zingage, and Pivotal Health". Entry year to be dated from the round announcement.

name: Zingage
basis: Firm's own post 2026-08-12: "have backed a number of companies automating operational workflows ... including Abridge, SmarterDx, QVentus, Ansible Health, Plenful, House Rx, Pivotal Health, Amperos, Zingage"; a Sofia Guerra board per the 2026-01-20 promotion post; headline 2025-11-18 "Zingage Raises $12.5M" (round year, investor list not read).

name: Perceptron
basis: Firm's own fund announcement (2026-09): "Roughly 70 percent of our investments are made at the early stage. Companies like Abridge, ChipAgents, fal, Noda, Perceptron, Plenful, TurbineOne, and Wonderful reflect that enduring commitment." Entry year inferred from a 2025 funding record headline (Perceptron AI), not read.

name: Moxie Beauty
basis: Firm's own post 2025-12-16: "Bessemer Venture Partners leads Moxie's $15M Series A to disrupt India's beauty market"; Entrackr same day: Bessemer led, Fireside Ventures participated; earlier rounds (2023 seed, 2024) had no Bessemer.

name: OFF/BEAT
basis: Bar and Bench 2026-05-07: "OffBeat Studios Private Limited, dba OFF/BEAT, has concluded a Series Seed funding round led by Bessemer Venture Partners (BVP) and Reed India." Announced 2026-04-07 (Rs 100 crore; boAt co-founder Aman Gupta).

name: Harmoni
basis: citybiz 2026-09-09: "Harmoni has raised $10 million in Series A funding led by Bessemer Venture Partners" (Akron, factory orchestration).

name: Furientis
basis: Fortune 2026-05-14: "Silent Ventures led the round with participation from Bessemer Venture Partners, SV Angel, Vanderbilt University, Channel 39 Ventures, and the founders of companies including Anduril and Armada."

name: DualBird
basis: citybiz 2026-01-27: "Lightspeed Venture Partners led the rounds, with participation from Bessemer Venture Partners, which has offices in Boston and New York, Angular Ventures and Uncork Capital." Seed plus Series A, $25M, announced 2025-11-05.

name: Fuel Me
basis: Company release 2024-03-20: Series A co-led by Pritzker Group Venture Capital and Tribeca Venture Partners; "Other new investors include Bessemer Venture Partners, Interplay Venture Capital, FJ Labs, HPA (Hyde Park Angels)..."

name: Earthly
basis: FinSMEs 2020-10-09: "The round was led by 468 Capital, joined by Uncorrelated Ventures, Bessemer Venture Partners, Hack VC and a number of founders of high-profile developer platforms" ($2.1M seed). Not in the 2023 Seed+ round (Innovation Endeavors led).

name: Triton Network Systems
basis: 10-K/A 2001: "Entities affiliated with Bessemer Venture Partners 1,947,489 5.5%" including "700,265 shares held by Bessemer Venture Partners IV, L.P. and 700,267 shares held by Bessec Ventures IV L.P."; chairman Robert Goodman a BVP partner. Triton listed July 2000, so the stake is a venture holding; record year is the 10-K/A (earlier prospectus not in the shard).

name: Grow Mobile
basis: 6-K: Grow Mobile 'is venture-backed by Signia Venture Partners and Bessemer Venture Partners'.

name: GMS Dental Group
basis: The Bessemer vehicle on Gentle Dental Service Corporation's filings (Bessemer Venture Partners GMS, then Bessemer Venture Partners IV) held stock issued on 1997-11-04, when the listed Gentle Dental merged the private GMS Dental Group into itself: the venture position was GMS Dental Group; the acquirer is out as sale consideration (decisions.md R6).
source: recall probe (judge jm, sale consideration; read 2026-10-01)
